summary: Frontend-only regression executed on public URL for marker interactions and chapter routing. Most targeted flows passed on desktop/mobile, but desktop timeline pointer strict loop showed one intermittent miss (4/5) before passing on immediate recheck (5/5), so deterministic stability is not fully proven yet.

ui_bugs.issue: Strict desktop pointer loop produced 4/5 exact passes in first regression run (run 3 stayed at circuit, progress 0.17); rerun passed 5/5, indicating intermittent behavior.

integration_issues.issue: Desktop exact-stop behavior is near-stable but still intermittently non-deterministic across repeated loop batches.

action_items: Investigate intermittent desktop miss where timeline click occasionally remains at circuit (0.17) during strict loop runs.
Re-validate strict acceptance in one uninterrupted batch: timeline 5/5 desktop + 5/5 mobile exact 0.305.
Keep current working behavior unchanged: legacy marker opens with six stats, cars marker reaches 0.37, Enter/Space marker activation, Back to Circuit overview, and no overflow/console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Final marker event wiring is correct in DOM (`data-testid` placed on `circle.marker-hit`, `onPointerDown` + keyboard handlers), and `elementFromPoint` resolves to the expected hit circle during recheck.
Decorative map layers are correctly non-interactive for pointer interception (`marker-pulse`, `marker-core`, hidden hero descendants), matching intent.
Observed instability appears timing-related in strict desktop loop batches, not a broad routing failure (mobile loop passed 5/5; desktop rerun passed 5/5).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run #1 summary: desktop timeline exact 4/5, mobile timeline exact 5/5. Additional desktop recheck in fresh run: timeline 5/5, legacy 3/3 (0.24), cars 3/3 (0.37). Enter and Space both routed timeline to 0.305. Legacy opens with six stats. Back to Circuit preserved overview copy. No horizontal overflow and no in-page error elements detected.
rca of the issue: Repro in first batch: set circuit immediate, click [data-testid='chapter-marker-timeline'], wait ~2.4s, repeat 5x; one desktop iteration remained at circuit/progress 0.17. Immediate follow-up batch passed fully, so issue is intermittent and likely timing/settle race across rapid repeated route resets rather than selector mismatch or persistent pointer interception.
